title: Sultan: The Saviour
desc: Raja Dutta and his sister Disha move to Kolkata to start afresh. But Disha is oblivious to Raja's past and his intention behind shifting to Kolkata.

title: Baba Keno Chakar
desc: When Rajnarayan asks his son to help out with the expenses for his sister's wedding, he refuses. As a result, he is forced to go from pillar to post to make ends meet.

title: Pratham Dekha
desc: Two struggling singers, who hope to make their way to the top, fall in love and fight to stay together amidst various societal barriers.

title: Aakrosh
desc: Two detectives investigate the disappearance of three medical students in a small village, but their search is hampered by corrupt local authorities.

title: Loafer
desc: Bikram is a selfless man who is unfairly hated by his family. However, after an arrest for helping a friend marry, he struggles to gain the respect of those he constantly protects.

title: Hirok Gorer Hire
desc: A hilarious heist unfolds as thieves target a priceless diamond from a wealthy landowner's estate, sparking romance and misadventures along the way.

title: Patanjali Yog - By Yogrishi Swami Ramdev
desc: Baba Ramdev emphasises the importance of yoga and demonstrates various asanas and breathing exercises that enable one to lead a healthy and stress-free life.
